name: ahu_chw_requests
description: Chilled-water requests from one air handler. The temperature error is supply air temperature minus its setpoint. Output yChiWatResReq is 3 when the error has been above high3_error for persistence seconds, else 2 when it has been above high2_error for persistence seconds, else 1 while the valve latch is set, else 0. A temperature condition, once on, stays on while the error remains above its threshold minus temperature_band, and ends at once otherwise; when it ends, its persistence count restarts the next time it comes on. The valve latch sets when the valve position goes above valve_open and clears when it goes below valve_reset; in between it keeps its state. The valve-open condition, once on, stays on until the valve is no longer above valve_open minus valve_band; each clear condition, once on, stays on until the valve is no longer below its threshold plus valve_band. Output yChiPlaReq is 1 while a second latch is set: it sets like the valve latch but clears only when the valve goes below valve_closed. Timing at the edges: all thresholds are strict (an error of exactly 3 K is not above 3 K; a valve of exactly 0.95 does not set a latch; exactly 0.85 or 0.10 does not clear one). A temperature condition already met at the first frame counts as having lasted, so its requests appear at once. A latch changes only when its set or clear condition turns on, and then becomes 'set and not clear' using the current values: a valve jumping in one frame from below valve_reset to above valve_open sets the latch, and a valve above valve_open at the first frame starts with both latches set.

params.name: high3_error
params.meaning: Error above which, held long enough, 3 requests are sent

params.name: high2_error
params.meaning: Error above which, held long enough, 2 requests are sent

params.name: temperature_band
params.meaning: Release band below each temperature threshold

params.name: persistence
params.meaning: How long a temperature condition must last before it counts

params.name: valve_open
params.meaning: Valve position above which both latches set

params.name: valve_reset
params.meaning: Valve position below which the reset-request latch clears

params.name: valve_closed
params.meaning: Valve position below which the plant-request latch clears

params.name: valve_band
params.meaning: Release band of each valve condition
